content_blocks.title: Core idea
content_blocks.text: This lesson focuses on **Detecting Duplicate Records**. Work through the listed subtopics (Using duplicated(), Checking duplicate keys, Controlling duplicate detection with subset, Controlling the keep parameter) as decisions in one small data workflow: identify the input and its labels, choose the relevant Pandas operation, then inspect the output shape, values, and types. Do not assume the result is correct solely because the code ran.

df = pd.DataFrame({"id": [1, 2, 2], "value": [4, 5, 6]})

content_blocks.title: Common mistakes and fixes
content_blocks.text: Avoid assuming inferred types are always correct, treating every repeated record as an error, or overlooking alignment by labels. Check the actual API documentation for the target version and assert the properties that matter to the task.
